opening.argument: The presentation combines a direct recruitment invitation with a paid, tiered participation structure. Viewers are told, “To join me at Onecoin: https://www.onecoin.eu/signup/thomasp31,” while participation is linked to a 45-euro cost and package-based selling limits. The stated tiers permit different daily amounts—12€, 36€, 60€, or 150€—making access and selling capacity depend on the selected package. The presentation also frames bonuses, sponsored members, and leadership status as features of participation. Rather than examining or warning about the offer, it operationally encourages involvement: “in this this tutorial, I will explain how you can sell you OneCoin.” These combined recruitment, paid access, tiered limits, and selling instructions support the conclusion that the offer is being promoted through a commission-based participation system.
